name: Researcher Phase Transition → ARCHITECT
description: ADR-041 Slice 2D-3 forward spawn rule. Fires when phasevalidator.PhaseValidator has approved a synthesize→architect transition and stamped chain.phase_transition.proceed.architect="true" on the source researcher-synthesize loop entity. The validator has checked the edge AND the per-phase cap (max 2 architect fires per chain). Same two-step fire shape as the other phase-transition rules.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher-architect
on_enter.prompt:
ARCHITECT phase entry. Source loop $entity.instance (researcher-synthesize) has handed off with decide(action="architect"). Call read_loop_result on that loop to read the synthesized research artifact. Extract concrete typed commitments + verification checks[] that bind the plan's verifiable outcomes to executable evidence per researcher-architect/00-identity.md. Use scratchpad to decompose actors → checks before the strict-schema emit_dev_via_spec_artifact call.

Terminal options (allow-list enforced by phasevalidator): decide(action="emit") forward terminal — closes the research arc, dev-via-spec reviewer evaluates next via 01b; decide(action="gather") back-edge if architecture surfaces an unindexed dep (bounded by gather cap=3); decide(action="needs_clarification") when the synthesized artifact is structurally insufficient for architecture.

metadata.proceed_sentinel: chain.phase_transition.proceed.architect on source researcher-synthesize loop entity
